_doc: Player profiles of the pacing optimizer (Step 50). bot: the play bot's way of playing (tools/playtest/autoplayer.gd profile). step_ms: time between decisions; first_ms: the first decision (the first look); explore_every: every Nth decision goes on looking around; tutorial_taps: stages done by hand before the tutorial turns to the Momo; minutes: default length; sell_at_points: the legacy points the player waits for before selling an island (human48: the two-day calendar's patient seller). 'blind' (v2) is calibrated on blind round B1 of Step 50 (taps 6-9 s apart, first tap 7-8 s); 'blind_v1' is the first calibration, on the Step 45 blind AI playtests of v0.49.0 (taps 9-11 s apart) -- see design/INCREMENTAL_PACING.md and INCREMENTAL_BALANCE_REPORT.md.
